name: LimX Dynamics
summary: LimX Dynamics is a Shenzhen robotics company founded in January 2022 that builds legged robots and the full-size Oli humanoid. Investors include Nio Capital and SAIC's Shangqi Capital.
funding: Series A in July 2024; $200 million Series B announced February 2026 (CnEVPost).

sources.title: Chinese humanoid robot maker LimX secures $200 million in Series B funding
